name: Pet Story 🐶
desc:
👋 Welcome to Pet Story: Rise and shine... You're getting ADOPTED! 

🐶 A sweet grannie has set her eyes on you, a new life awaits, but not everyone is so happy, in the distance from a cold cage red eyes full of anger look at you...
A pet who is well known, and it is not because of his good character...
Prepare yourself, because you're about to face the dangers of the real world!

👍 Don't forget to like and join the group if you enjoy the game and would like to see more updates!
